command:
set -o pipefail
repo="/home/ai-core-node/.cache/omegacv1-main-93a44ca-canonical-stage"
cd "$repo"
echo '=== DIRTY DIFF STAT ==='
git diff --stat
echo '=== LOCAL HEAD STAT ==='
git show --stat --oneline --decorate --no-renames HEAD | head -120
echo '=== MATERIALIZER RELEVANT ==='
grep -nE 'vendor|RESYNC|overlay/internal/ui|patch_landing|UPSTREAM|CRUSH|git clone|cp -a|rsync' scripts/materialize-harness.sh | head -220
echo '=== UI OVERLAY TREE ==='
find harness/overlay/internal/ui -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort
echo '=== UI VENDOR TOP TREE ==='
find harness/vendor/internal/ui -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sed 's#^harness/vendor/##' | sort | head -220
echo '=== PATCHES ==='
find harness/patches -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort
echo '=== OMEGA STATUS UI ==='
sed -n '1,260p' harness/overlay/internal/ui/model/omega_status.go 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== LANDING PATCH ==='
sed -n '1,260p' harness/patches/patch_landing.py 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== UPDATE PROVIDERS ==='
sed -n '1,280p' harness/vendor/internal/cmd/update_providers.go 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== CRUSH SELF UPDATE ==='
sed -n '1,280p' harness/vendor/internal/update/update.go 2>/dev/null || true
